params.body:
## What

Scrolling to the end of the holding page and pulling further showed white under the black. The same happens under the black footer on every page since #125.

The document ground was the `<body>`'s white (`bg-surface`), because the body's background becomes the canvas when `<html>` has none. The pages now end in black, so the elastic bounce past the end revealed that white.

## How

On the site layout and on the bare layout (the holding page), `<html>` carries `bg-night` (#1d1d1b), so the canvas under the page is her black, and `overscroll-y-none`, so the bounce is off where the browser honours it and neither edge can show a seam. The body keeps its white and still covers the content.

## Checked

The build emits `overscroll-behavior-y:none`, the Tailwind check, Pint and the PHP suite pass. `HeroCollageTest` pins the root classes on the holding page and on a subpage.
params.title: No white under the black: the page ground is her black and the bounce is off
